name: Paperclip
description: Paperclip is an open-source AI coding agent platform. This image is maintained by BitCryptic and built from the official Paperclip source with Unraid compatibility in mind. Requires a PostgreSQL database (e.g. a separate Postgres container). Set DATABASE_URL to your connection string before starting. BETTER_AUTH_SECRET must be set to a securely generated random string (e.g. openssl rand -base64 32). ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is required for Claude-based agents. PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL should be set to the URL users will access Paperclip from (e.g. http://your-server-ip:3100).

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to access the Paperclip web interface.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Random secret for session signing. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
variables.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-based agents.

variables.name: PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The URL users will access Paperclip from. Must match your reverse proxy or direct IP.

variables.name: PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE
variables.description: Set to 'authenticated' for private use or 'public' for open access.

variables.name: SERVE_UI
variables.description: Serve the web UI from the same process.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of trusted origins for auth (e.g. http://your-server-ip:3100). Required if accessing from multiple URLs.
